steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: A tort is a civil wrong — the claimant sues the defendant for compensation, unlike criminal law where the state prosecutes | Key Fact: Negligence is the most common tort — it requires duty of care, breach of that duty, causation and resulting damage | Key Fact: Duty of care exists where the defendant owed a legal duty to the claimant — established by the Caparo three-stage test | Key Fact: The Caparo test requires: (1) foreseeability of harm, (2) proximity of relationship and (3) it is fair, just and reasonable to impose a duty
